narrative.scqa_md:
BOK Financial Corporation is a $52.2B in assets regional bank regulated by OCC, operating since 1910 with 6,719 employees. A 2.9% multi-year growth rate and fundamentals of efficiency 66.70% give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-003, E-004]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 1.9/5. The deepest capability gap is Analytics & AI Strategy at 1.4/5 against a 1.5 peer median [E-021, E-005].

Next is Identity Resolution & Unified Customer Profile at 1.4/5 against a 2.0 peer median [E-056]. Third is Document Ingestion at 1.6/5 against a 2.5 peer median. The issue register adds Proof completeness 54.3% (target ≥95%). Counter-signal: Customer Intelligence Foundation already runs at 1.5/5 against a 1.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild.

The pattern is corroborated across the assessment's evidence index [E-002]. The question for BOK Financial Corporation is whether to close Analytics & AI Strategy first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. BOK Financial Corporation should lead with Tableau (50/100 fit) against Audience Segmentation & Activation, then sequence nCino behind it. Closing Analytics & AI Strategy to the peer median alone is worth 0.1 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.

The analyst's own priority framing: "CDO Has IT Infrastructure Background — CDO David Poczynek holds dual title (CDO + Acting Dir Infrastructure & Ops) with IT audit/DR background — not data governance specialist…".
